name: Wash-off face mask
definition: cream, clay, gel or peel mask spread on the face and rinsed off after a set time.
reason: Masks leaf holds only sheet and sleeping masks; shops sell wash-off masks as their own type.

name: Self-tanner
definition: lotion, mousse, drops or spray that tans the skin without sun, usually by DHA.
reason: Not bronzer (makeup colour); the leaf was the tanning home before its rename.

name: Styling cream
definition: leave-in cream worked through hair to define, smooth or hold a style.
reason: Styling leaf holds only hairspray and heat protectant; styling creams are a shop category.
